deliveroo.source: sales: Deliveroo Weekly Brand Report (GBP 1 rounding); orders: Deliveroo Daily Master delivered, Mon-Sun + ops from Weekly Summary sheet

issues: Sales were £44,386, beating the £42K target by about £2.3K (5.7%), with spend per head at £23.08 (Soho GM/HC meeting 24/11 and London KPI meeting 24/11).
Wages were 24.3% against a 23% target, so wages must stay below 24% with 23% as the aim, and managers must speak to BOH three times a day to adjust labour.
Food cost fell to 20.86% from 25%, with food variance at minus 1.1%; efficiency was 85%, with 90% possible after the soft launch.
Reviews: 22 five star, two 4 star and one 3 star (steak too chewy), no 1 or 2 star reviews, and a Google rating of 4.84.

Delivery sales dropped by £1,636 (about 10%) despite a 4.8 star rating, with longer rider wait and prep times on Wednesday (14.5 minute average prep), missing items disputed on Deliveroo and riders hiding tags and scanning early.
Three people starting at 11am was too many, so it is now two for FOH and bar, with the spare time used for deep cleaning.
Edamame, still and sparkling water and pints are being pushed as non negotiable upsells, and more sushi and edamame upselling is needed.
Flooring maintenance was done, but dishwasher maintenance is still pending.
A 50 cover Christmas booking was moved from Soho to Shoreditch without Shoreditch being told.
The team is preparing for the Nori merge and opening upstairs soon, with the Soho strip out and fit out running from 22/11 to 30/11 (Ross Ward weekly report w/c 16/11).
Hygiene checks were 100% for the bar, bathrooms and BOH, and waste was recorded.
Promotions: Christmas set menu, Christmas menu and Christmas matcha.
Tam has joined as the new area manager for London and South and will visit the sites with Ziang Lin.
